title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
code: age_lower(x, invalid = c("error", "warn", "silent"))  age_upper(x, invalid = c("error", "warn", "silent"))  age_width(x, invalid = c("error", "warn", "silent"))  age_mid(x, invalid = c("error", "warn", "silent"))

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
text: x vector age group labels. invalid Action label interpreted. Choices "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
text: numeric vector length x.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter age. See examples. age_mid() uses formula age_lower(x) + 0.5 * age_width(x), except open age groups, "100+", uses age_lower(x) + 0.5 * median_width median_width median closed intervals.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
code: x <- c("5-9", "10-14", "100+") age_lower(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5    10   100  age_upper(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>    10    15   Inf  age_width(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5     5   Inf  age_mid(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>   7.5  12.5 102.5   ## use 'age_lower()' to filter on age library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(   ~age, ~count,                 "5-9",     11,               "10-14",     20,                "100+",      7 )        df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 5-9      11 #> 2 10-14    20 #> 3 100+      7 df |> filter(age_lower(age) >= 10) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 10-14    20 #> 2 100+      7  ## no action when label invalid age_lower(c("0-4", "young people", "50plus"),           invalid = "silent") #>         0-4 youngpeople         50+  #>           0          NA          50

text: x vector period labels. label_single Whether labels single-year periods based lower upper limit period. title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter periods. See examples.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
code: x <- c("2025-2030", "2020-2025", "2030-2035") period_lower(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2025      2020      2030  period_upper(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2030      2025      2035  period_width(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>         5         5         5  period_mid(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>    2027.5    2022.5    2032.5   ## use 'period_lower()' to filter on period library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(    ~period, ~count,               "2020-2025",     20,               "2025-2030",      5,               "2030-2035",     11 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2020-2025    20 #> 2 2025-2030     5 #> 3 2030-2035    11 df |> filter(period_lower(period) >= 2025) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030     5 #> 2 2030-2035    11  ## 'label_single' is "lower" (the default) period_lower("2025") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_upper("2025") #> 2025  #> 2026  period_width("2025") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_single' is "upper" period_lower("2025", label_single = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2024  period_upper("2025", label_single = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_width("2025", label_single = "upper") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_multi' is "include" (the default) period_lower("2025-2029") #> 2025-2029  #>      2025  period_upper("2025-2029") #> 2025-2029  #>      2029  period_width("2025-2029") #> 2025-2029  #>         4   ## 'label_multi' is "exclude" period_lower("2025-2029", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2029  #>      2025  period_upper("2025-2029", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2029  #>      2030  period_width("2025-2029", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2029  #>         5   ## no action when label invalid period_lower(c("2000-2005", "long time ago"),              invalid = "silent") #>   2000-2005 longtimeago  #>        2000          NA
